books.name: Genesis
books.about: Beginning of the world, the family, and the promise that outlives a flood.

books.name: Exodus
books.about: A people leave a kingdom. The law is given on the mountain.

books.name: Leviticus
books.about: How a camp stays fit to approach what is holy.

books.name: Numbers
books.about: The long count in the wilderness, and the complaints that stretch it.

books.name: Deuteronomy
books.about: The law said again, on the edge of the land, before Moses stops.

books.name: Joshua
books.about: Crossing in, and the division of what was promised.

books.name: Judges
books.about: When there was no king, the same fall happens in a cycle.

books.name: Ruth
books.about: A foreigner stays, and a family line continues through a field.

books.name: Samuel
books.about: Counted as one book. The last judge, then Saul, then David.

books.name: Kings
books.about: Counted as one book. The throne splits, and the exile closes it.

books.name: 1 Chronicles
books.about: The same kingdom, told through names, worship, and David's house.

books.name: 2 Chronicles
books.about: Temple, kings of Judah, and the fall that sends them away.

books.name: Kufale (Jubilees)
books.about: Genesis retold in jubilee weeks. The canon keeps it beside the Law.

books.name: Henok (1 Enoch)
books.about: Visions of judgment, watchers, and a figure called the Son of Man.

books.name: Ezra and Nehemiah
books.about: Counted together. The return, the wall, and the reading of the law.

books.name: Ezra (2nd) and Ezra Sutuel
books.about: Counted as one. Later Ezra traditions, questions after the ruin.

books.name: Tobit
books.about: A blind man, a journey, and a burial no one else would do.

books.name: Judith
books.about: A city under siege, and one woman who ends the general.

books.name: Esther
books.about: A court, a decree, and a people who were not supposed to survive it.

books.name: 1 Meqabyan
books.about: Ethiopic, not the Greek Maccabees. A king's test of three brothers.

books.name: II and III Meqabyan
books.about: Counted as one canonical book. Further Meqabyan stories of fidelity under kings.

books.name: Job
books.about: A good man loses everything and will not take a cheap answer.

books.name: Psalms
books.about: The prayer book. Praise, anger, and the long wait, side by side.

books.name: Proverbs
books.about: Short instruction. Wisdom is pictured as someone you can refuse.

books.name: Tegsat
books.about: The Book of Correction. Counted apart from Proverbs in this canon.

books.name: Wisdom of Solomon
books.about: A defense of wisdom, and of the righteous who die early.

books.name: Ecclesiastes
books.about: The collector says the work under the sun does not keep what it earns.

books.name: Song of Solomon
books.about: Love poems. The canon did not blush and take them out.

books.name: Sirach
books.about: Joshua ben Sirach's instruction. Practical, sharp, and long.

books.name: Isaiah
books.about: Judgment on a proud city, then a servant, then a road home.

books.name: Jeremiah
books.about: Counted with the laments and Baruch in this tradition. The prophet who was not believed.

books.name: Ezekiel
books.about: A vision by the river, a ruined temple, and dry bones told to stand.

books.name: Daniel
books.about: A court in exile. Dreams, a furnace, and a count of empires.

books.name: Hosea
books.about: A marriage used as a picture of a people who keep leaving.

books.name: Amos
books.about: A herdsman against worship that ignores the poor.

books.name: Micah
books.about: What is required: do justly, love mercy, walk humbly.

books.name: Joel
books.about: Locusts, then a promise that the spirit is poured out.

books.name: Obadiah
books.about: The shortest prophet. A word against Edom for standing aside.

books.name: Jonah
books.about: A prophet runs, a city repents, and he is angry that mercy worked.

books.name: Nahum
books.about: Nineveh, later. The empire that Jonah spared does not last.

books.name: Habakkuk
books.about: A complaint: why do the violent keep the field?

books.name: Zephaniah
books.about: A day of the Lord, and a remnant told to sing anyway.

books.name: Haggai
books.about: Stop paneling your own houses. The temple is still in rubble.

books.name: Zechariah
books.about: Night visions after the return, and a king who comes lowly.

books.name: Malachi
books.about: The last of the twelve. A messenger, and a question about tired offerings.

books.name: The Josippon
books.about: A history of the Jews kept in the broader count. Not the Greek Josephus.

books.name: Matthew
books.about: The gospel written for readers who know the law and the prophets.

books.name: Mark
books.about: The short gospel. It starts at once and keeps moving.

books.name: Luke
books.about: An ordered account, written so a reader can know what was delivered.

books.name: John
books.about: The gospel that begins before the beginning, and stays on the word.

books.name: Acts
books.about: What the witnesses did after the ascension, city by city.

books.name: Romans
books.about: Paul's long argument: righteousness, the law, and a people grafted in.

books.name: 1 Corinthians
books.about: A divided church. The body, the supper, and love that outlasts gifts.

books.name: 2 Corinthians
books.about: Paul defends a ministry that looks weak and keeps going.

books.name: Galatians
books.about: Do not add a second gate to a freedom already given.

books.name: Ephesians
books.about: One new people, and a household ordered by that fact.

books.name: Philippians
books.about: A letter from custody. Joy, and a mind set on what is ahead.

books.name: Colossians
books.about: Christ is enough. Do not let extra visions demote him.

books.name: 1 Thessalonians
books.about: A young church, and a word about those who have died.

books.name: 2 Thessalonians
books.about: Do not quit work because you think the day has already come.

books.name: 1 Timothy
books.about: How a congregation is led, and what a teacher is for.

books.name: 2 Timothy
books.about: Paul's last charge. Keep the deposit.

books.name: Titus
books.about: Set the churches in Crete in order, and do not fight about genealogies.

books.name: Philemon
books.about: A personal letter about Onesimus, sent back as more than a servant.

books.name: Hebrews
books.about: The priesthood, the sacrifice, and a better covenant argued in full.

books.name: James
books.about: Faith that never moves a hand is called dead, plainly.

books.name: 1 Peter
books.about: How to live when you are strangers and the pressure is real.

books.name: 2 Peter
books.about: A warning against teachers who use freedom as a cover.

books.name: 1 John
books.about: God is light. Love is the test that the claim is true.

books.name: 2 John
books.about: A short letter: walk in truth, and do not host a false teaching.

books.name: 3 John
books.about: Hospitality praised, and one man who shut the door.

books.name: Jude
books.about: Contend for the faith. It cites Enoch, which this canon also keeps.

books.name: Revelation
books.about: A vision to seven churches. Beasts, a city, and a last invitation.

books.name: Mashafa Kidan I
books.about: First Book of the Covenant. Church order counted in the broader 81.

books.name: Mashafa Kidan II
books.about: Second Book of the Covenant. Rules for the community, not a gospel.

books.name: Sirate Tsion
books.about: The Order of Zion. One of the Sinodos books attributed to the apostles.

books.name: Te'ezaz
books.about: The Book of Command. Another Sinodos section in the church-order count.

books.name: Gitzew
books.about: Part of the Sinodos. Kept in the eight books added to reach 35 in the New Testament count.

books.name: Abtilis
books.about: Part of the Sinodos. Church order, not narrative gospel.

books.name: Didascalia
books.about: Teaching on the order of the church. Counted among the eight.

books.name: Qalementos
books.about: Ethiopic Clement. A letter in the tradition of Peter to Clement, distinct from 1 and 2 Clement.
